panels.headline: Dad Fixes Everything
panels.body: For every quiet fix, every small rescue, and every thing you handled before anyone asked.
panels.art_direction: Clean, printable workshop illustration with a golden yellow and green accent palette. The dominant composition archetype is a cinematic single-object cover with a large toolbox as the hero. The toolbox is centered and has a thin refined frame. The interior is quiet with a low-contrast background and sparse edge/corner motifs. The safe-margin plan is generous, with a clean text-safe area reserved for the app overlay.
